ai.overview: Ohio State brings the lineal championship belt to the Kohl Center to face undefeated Wisconsin on November 13, 2026. The Buckeyes claimed the belt in their most recent outing, a 5–2 victory over Michigan, but have yet to defend it in this reign. Wisconsin has never held the belt in program history and will look to claim it for the first time against a struggling 3-4 Ohio State squad.
key_matchups: Wisconsin's perfect 6-0 start and five-game winning streak against Ohio State's inconsistent 3-4 record
The Buckeyes' historical edge in the all-time series (38-20-5) versus the Badgers' dominant recent form
Ohio State defending the belt for the first time this reign after claiming it with the 5–2 win over Michigan
ai.betting_angles: Wisconsin enters on a five-game winning streak with dominant recent victories, including a 9–1 dismantling of Notre Dame in their last outing. Ohio State sits at 3-4 and has dropped three of their last five games, showing inconsistency despite the recent Michigan win. The Elo model favors Wisconsin as clear favorites, aligning with their undefeated record and current form advantage.
ai.prediction_writeup: Wisconsin's perfect 6-0 record and five-game winning streak, capped by the 9–1 victory over Notre Dame, suggests a team playing at peak form. Ohio State's 3-4 record reflects their struggles this season, and while they just won 5–2 against Michigan to claim the belt, they've been inconsistent overall. The Elo model backing Wisconsin as clear favorites confirms what the numbers show. Despite Ohio State's historical dominance in the all-time series (38-20-5), the Badgers' current momentum should prove too much for the visiting belt holder.
